svg.title: Throughput and p99 latency by Mechanism and load level
svg.desc: Grouped bars, one group per load level (hammer-seat 10, hammer-seat 100, hammer-seat 1000, spread-seats 1000), one bar per Mechanism and the Control. Top panel is throughput in requests per second, bottom panel is p99 latency in milliseconds. Each Mechanism and the Control has its own fill pattern.
svg.text: Throughput and p99 latency by Mechanism and load level
Exhibit C. Mean across repeats per cell; one machine, containerized Postgres. Higher throughput is better, lower p99 is better.
